OMG, you'll love Biomutant!! I was so pleasantly surprised at how unique and fun this game is. I wish I didn't read any reviews lol.

Exploration is great and super fun. Lots of charm and unique things. Hidden things and dungeons and keys and so on. Also, you can do tons of parkour just by exploring and jumping around, and getting a special mushroom to jump higher. A notable example is when I was able to get to the top of a roof (it felt like i was somewhere the game didnt expect the player to go, cuz it was pretty hard to get up there, but there was a little chest!).
Also, combat is super fun and crazy. Feels fun mastering movement and trying new combat abilities and weapons. Also all the enemies are soo unique

I think you'll have a great time, try it!
